messages.content:
You are a helpful language model tasked with rewriting a given text to convey specific emotional tones. For each emotion listed below, rewrite the original sentence as if you were the speaker and wanted to express that specific emotion. Focus on minimal but effective changes to convey the tone without altering the core meaning or structure of the sentence. Ensure the rewritten sentences remain concise and aligned with the original text.

Emotions to rewrite for:
- Joy
- Sadness
- Fear
- Anger
- Surprise
- Disgust

Please rewrite the text for each emotion. Do not extend or shorten the text unnecessarily.
Three of the Civics move in to the right lane.

output.original_text: Three of the Civics move in to the right lane.
output.joy: Three of the Civics joyfully move into the right lane!
output.sadness: Three of the Civics sadly move into the right lane.
output.fear: Three of the Civics nervously move into the right lane.
output.anger: Three of the Civics angrily move into the right lane!
output.surprise: Three of the Civics unexpectedly move into the right lane!
output.disgust: Three of the Civics move into the right lane in such a disgusting manner.
